about_the_game:
A desktop idle game

  • Freely manage your game windows and create your personalized desktop gallery.

  • While you handle other tasks, send heroes on parallel adventures in a fantasy world.

Develop unique heroes

  • Each hero has a distinct appearance and fighting style.

  • Heroes grow through adventures and tasks. You can freely change their points, equipment, and throwable items.

  • You can also feed your heroes food, which provides various useful buffs.

Explore dynamic maps

  • Each map has unique mechanics, such as grinding mobs, farming, mining, selling items, divination, and challenging powerful bosses.

  • As you progress, the maps will also develop, and the rewards will become richer.

  • Dispatch heroes to various maps to acquire resources and cleverly adjust strategies for better gains.

Craft useful items

  • Unlock recipes through various means, gather materials, and crafted higher-level items.

  • Crafted items not only have unique functions but can also be sold for a better price in shops.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15
  • Processor: x86_64 or ARM CPU (Apple Silicon)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Deskeroes is a desktop idle game allows you to build and dispatch heroes to battle monsters, farm resources, mine, manage stores, and engage in other interesting activities within a fantasy world.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish
